Cassie: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @Priya for swooping in on the canary rollback during the all-hands. Saved the demo and my caffeine levels. :raised_hands:
Priya: no prob! found the bad config, hotfixed and restarted. small snippet: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/canary canary=redwood/canary:v2.1.3`
Matt: Priya and infra team = elite. Also appreciated the calm updates in the thread. :trophy:
Samantha: Also thx to @Oscar for spotting the metric spike. Would love a 15-min retro tomorrow to capture learning.
Oscar: happy to. i'll drop a short doc in #docs after the retro.
Infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed at 2024-07-03T14:22:10Z (id: cb8f3)
Priya: cookies for the team? 🍪
Cassie: :cookie: count me in. I'll order from the bakery — quick vote: chocolate chip or lemon?
Sam: chocolate chip :+1:
Matt: lemon all the way :lemon:
Priya: looks like chocolate chip wins. i'll DM folks about pickup logistics.
Kevin: Huge props from CS — that demo was customer-facing, this saved the day.
Cassie: Recording this as a kudos for the weekly roundup. Thanks y'all. :sparkles:
